positive_snippets:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Excellent Stay – Highly Recommended!
I had a wonderful experience staying at this hotel. From the moment I arrived, the staff was extremely polite, professional, and always ready to help. The check-in process was smooth and hassle-free.
The room was clean, spacious, and well-maintained with all the necessary amenities. The bed was very comfortable, and the overall atmosphere was calm and relaxing. Housekeeping did a great job every day.
The food was delicious with a good variety of options, and the restaurant staff provided excellent service. The location of the hotel is also perfect—easy to access and close to important places.
Overall, this hotel exceeded my expectations in terms of comfort, service, and cleanliness. I would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a pleasant and comfortable stay. I look forward to staying here again!

negative_snippets:
I had arranged for my father-in-law to stay at this hotel. When I went to meet him, they did not even allow me to see him for two minutes. If you arrange for a guest to stay somewhere, it is natural that you would go to meet them. The hotel staff should cooperate in such situations.
One of the hotel staff members doesn’t even have the manners to speak properly. They should learn how to talk to customers and how to deal with them professionally.
